questions.refined_query: Show the name and country of singers who performed in concerts in 2014.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name, T1.country FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.singer_id = T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T2.concert_id = T3.concert_id WHERE T3.year = 2014

questions.refined_query: List all song names by singers above the average age.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT song_name FROM singer WHERE age > (SELECT avg(age) FROM singer)

questions.refined_query: Show location and name for all stadiums with a capacity between 5000 and 10000.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT location, name FROM stadium WHERE capacity BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000

questions.refined_query: Show the names of singers who have not performed in any concert.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT name FROM singer WHERE singer_id NOT IN (SELECT singer_id FROM singer_in_concert)

questions.refined_query: Show stadium names and the highest year of concerts held in each stadium.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT T2.name, max(T1.year) FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id = T2.stadium_id GROUP BY T1.stadium_id

questions.refined_query: List the names of singers who performed in any concert with theme 'Musicals'.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.singer_id = T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T2.concert_id = T3.concert_id WHERE T3.theme = 'Musicals'

questions.refined_query: Show the names and countries of singers who have performed at stadiums with a capacity above 5000.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name, T1.country FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.singer_id = T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T2.concert_id = T3.concert_id JOIN stadium AS T4 ON T3.stadium_id = T4.stadium_id WHERE T4.capacity > 5000

questions.refined_query: What is the average number of singers per concert?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT avg(sub.cnt) FROM (SELECT concert_id, count(singer_id) AS cnt FROM singer_in_concert GROUP BY concert_id) sub

questions.refined_query: What percentage of singers are male?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(sum(CASE WHEN is_male = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / count(singer_id) FROM singer

questions.refined_query: Show the top 3 stadiums with the most distinct singers who have performed there, along with the singer count.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT T1.name, count(DISTINCT T3.singer_id) AS total FROM stadium AS T1 JOIN concert AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id = T2.stadium_id JOIN singer_in_concert AS T3 ON T2.concert_id = T3.concert_id GROUP BY T1.stadium_id, T1.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3
